Operating Controls

Working Sequence

1. Start the boiler.
2. Fuel enters the furnace.
3. Air is supplied for combustion.
4. Heat passes through heating surfaces.
5. Feed water receives heat and becomes steam.
6. Steam leaves through the steam outlet.
7. Flue gas travels to the chimney.
